title: Quick Bite
description: With this mod, you will never need to check your hunger bar while AFK; it does it by itself!
body:
## **🍖 QuickBite**
*Hungry? Not anymore.*

---

**🔧 What does it do?**
Tired of dying because you forgot to eat? QuickBite automatically eats food from your hotbar the moment your hunger drops low — so you can focus on what actually matters.

---

**🎲 How does it work?**
Press **H** (changeable in **Options → Controls**) to toggle QuickBite on or off. When enabled, it watches your hunger bar and automatically eats the first food it finds in your hotbar as soon as you drop below 7 hunger points.

---

**✅ Features**
- 🍗 Fully automatic — eats for you when hunger gets low
- 🔍 Smart hotbar search — finds and switches to food automatically
- 🔇 Completely silent — no chat messages, no notifications
- ⚡ Lightweight — zero performance impact
- 🎮 Client-side only — works on any server
- 🔁 Simple toggle — press H anytime to enable or disable

---

**📦 Requirements for T1**
- Minecraft 1.21+
- Fabric Loader (mostly the version(s) will be/are fabric) 
- Fabric API

---
